title: Subgaussian bound for a sampled Fourier observation
statement: Let $n,m$ be natural numbers, let $S$ be a finite subset of $	ext{Fin}(n)$, let $i\in\text{Fin}(m)$, and let the target be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Under the product law of $m$ independent uniform cube inputs, the centered Fourier observation at coordinate $i$ has subgaussian moment-generating-function bound with parameter $1$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean target function on the n-dimensional sign cube
product law of m independent uniform cube inputs
